qa.overall_assessment: Currency system redesign is comprehensive and correct. All 11 requirements verified. Config has clean structure. All 14 'in USD' occurrences removed from 7 agent files, currency_local instruction added to all 8. HTML generator simplified: _to_cny, _load_eur_to_cny_rate, _load_cross_rates_to_cny methods removed; _to_display_currency uses clean division. Data files corrected with realistic CNY values. Validation scripts enhanced with currency consistency checks. Live HTML deployment at travel.life-ai.app shows correct EUR prices (Gaodu Hotel: EUR 42, Datong HSR: EUR 18.4). All 16 HIGH severity issues in plan-validate are pre-existing timeline overlaps, zero currency-related HIGHs. No regressions introduced.

root_cause_verification.rationale: Root cause was fragmented multi-directional currency model (commit 3d5971b). Fix replaces the entire model: (1) config rewritten from dual-field to single exchange_rates map, (2) agent prompts unified from USD to currency_local, (3) HTML generator conversion simplified from multi-hop to single division, (4) validation enforcement added at save and validate layers, (5) data files corrected from mislabeled values. All three upstream sources (config schema, agent instructions, conversion algorithm) are fixed, unlike prior attempts that only patched symptoms.
